name: Microchip ATmega328P (AVR, 5V on Uno/Nano)
logic_voltage_note: Logic = VCC (1.8-5.5V). Uno and Nano run it at 5V: outputs swing to 5V. 3.3V-only parts (SSD1306 bare chip, many sensors) need a level shifter or a 3.3V-tolerant module.
gpio_numbering: Arduino pin numbers (D0-D13, A0-A5 = 14-19, A6/A7 = 20/21 analog-only on TQFP/QFN). Port aliases in label_aliases.

flash_psram_gpio.notes: Internal flash; no external memory pins. ISP programming uses D11-D13 (MOSI/MISO/SCK) + RESET.

usb_note: No native USB; Uno/Nano use a USB-serial chip on D0/D1.

caution_gpio.0: RX, wired to the USB-serial chip; using it blocks uploads/Serial
caution_gpio.1: TX, wired to the USB-serial chip
caution_gpio.13: SPI SCK and the onboard LED on Arduino boards

board_level.SDA/SCL: A4/A5 (Uno R3 also duplicates them near AREF)

provenance.notes: Pin voltage limit VCC+0.5V quoted from datasheet absolute max. 'five_v_tolerant' is true only because VCC is 5V on Uno/Nano.
